name: Description Control
description: Declarative preset for sensory economy and setting load. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Place description where it changes mood, information, or blocking, then stop.
writing_goals: Prefer one decisive image over a catalog
Filter setting through the POV's current concern
Use sensory mix to mark place, not to decorate every paragraph
Cut description that does not alter action, mood, or knowledge
constraints: Do not inventory rooms unless the inventory is a clue or obstacle
Do not default to visual-only description
Do not paste travel-guide exposition into live scenes
checklist: Each descriptive beat has a job
At least two senses appear in a major setting entrance
POV bias is visible in what is noticed
No paragraph exists only as scenery
